messages:
Alex C: Starterkit sample app failing parity between TS + Py SDKs w/ structured output + function calls when auth retry happens.
Maria S: Paste the failure?
Alex C: Runtime error: ValidationError: payload did not match schema at .result — payload: '{"id":1,"result":{"status":"ok"}}\n' parse_error: unexpected token at end of JSON
ci-bot: [build] sample-app-tests failed — logs https://ci.redwood/s/1234
Samir P: Looks like an extra newline or double-encoding. Any sanitizer on TS side?
Priya K: Repro'd. TS helper (sdk/helpers/formatResult.ts) appends newline for json-mode; retry wrapper then JSON.stringifys again in the 401->retry path. TS signs json_str (no newline) whereas Py signs json_str + '\n'. On retry we end up with a quoted string containing an escaped newline, so server validator fails.
Maria S: Two fixes: (1) retry wrapper should not re-stringify if body is already a string or Buffer and content-type is application/json; (2) signing must be over canonical raw bytes matching Py (include newline if helper added it).
Samir P: Quick patch: const payloadToSend = (typeof opts.body === 'string' || opts.body instanceof Buffer) ? opts.body : JSON.stringify(opts.body); use payloadToSend for signing. Also assert content-type exists.
Priya K: Also watch streaming delimiter: json-mode helper adds a trailing newline as delimiter. Validator should not be relaxed; SDKs must canonicalize consistently.
Alex C: Action items: Priya to patch TS retry wrapper; Samir to add unit tests asserting signature parity with Py; Maria to add e2e sample that simulates transient 401 and verifies received raw bytes equal expected (including newline).
Priya K: Opening PR tonight with a small change to retry.ts and tests.
ci-bot: PR #4823 opened by priya-k: "ts: avoid double-serialize + sign canonical payload" — https://ci.redwood/p/4823
Maria S: Also add a note to the SDK migration guide: "do not re-serialize if json-mode already serialized the body." New users keep tripping on this.
Samir P: I'll update devex docs and include minimal repro snippet.
Priya K: I'll add test for function-call payload shape to prevent array coercion + stringify combos from happening.
Alex C: Once merged, run sample-app CI to confirm. :rocket: 
Maria S: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
